name: DS Metal Works
old_description: DS Metal Works specializes in handcrafted custom range hoods that blend architectural design with expert metal fabrication. From elegant brass accents to seamless stainless steel construction and custom paint finishes, each hood is fabricated to order for homeowners, designers, builders, and architects who demand exceptional quality.
about:
DS Metal Works, based in Falls Church, Virginia, has been operating since 1945. The company provides custom sheet metal fabrication for residential, commercial, and industrial clients throughout the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area.

The shop produces custom range hoods, kitchen ventilation systems, architectural metalwork, and stainless steel fabrications, along with HVAC ductwork, commercial kitchen equipment, and structural components. Its process moves from consultation and CAD-based design through fabrication to delivery and installation, handling one-off specialty pieces as well as larger commercial projects.

Customers include homeowners, designers, builders, architects, contractors, and business owners in the food-service and commercial sectors. Projects have ranged from a replacement grill grease catcher to full commercial kitchen build-outs and artistic installations such as a large-scale United States map display.

The company emphasizes integrity, quality craftsmanship, innovation, and customer satisfaction as core values, aiming to deliver attention to detail and reliable service on every job.
